name: Jaya King
summary: Quilted-pattern muralist (21st Tapestry, Franklin NDC) and exhibiting encaustic painter. Pattern work has a refined, design-savvy feel.
suitability: Pattern-led abstraction suits a non-figurative anchor wall well.

name: Micah Crandall-Bear
summary: Color-field horizon abstractions — atmospheric, gallery-grade canvases. Less mural-oriented but highly purchasable.
suitability: Better for rotating gallery walls or hospitality-tier interiors than for permanent murals.

name: Stephanie Taylor
summary: Long-time Sacramento public-mural artist; Dance: A Tribute and a roster of city-historical pieces.
suitability: Civic-leaning storytelling — a heritage-tone counterweight to the contemporary roster.

name: Franceska Gamez
summary: Floral-portraiture and phoenix iconography; Wide Open Walls and Branded Arts roster artist.
suitability: Lush palette translates well to high-traffic walls; Branded Arts rep simplifies booking.

name: Anthony Padilla
summary: Aerosol-trained character & abstract muralist; vibrant, kid-friendly when leveraged that way.
suitability: Character work is family-mall friendly; can scale to corridor-length pieces.

name: Groundswell Art
medium: Gallery curation · Hospitality + multifamily art programs
summary: Art consultancy + gallery (Eleanor Apartments install, Fort Sutter Hotel gallery). Strong roster reach across the Sacramento-rooted artist pool.
suitability: Best-in-region curator for a mall-scale program — consider as a primary partner.

name: NINE dot ARTS
summary: National art-consulting agency with deep hospitality/multifamily/corporate experience. Bigger budgets and longer timelines than local agencies.
suitability: Use only if scope expands beyond Sacramento-local artists — national reach but lower local rooting.

name: Ink and Indigo
summary: Represented through Kevin Barry Art Advisory; pattern-driven ink and indigo work with decorative appeal but unverified Sacramento ties or mural-scale experience.
suitability: Decorative ink-and-indigo palette would read warmly in family-retail settings, but Sacramento connection and public-art scale are unconfirmed through the advisory listing.

name: Susannah Mira
kind: Artist · Texas (via Kevin Barry Art Advisory)
summary: Texas-based sculptor working in reclaimed materials and large-scale installation; represented by Kevin Barry Art Advisory.
suitability: Reclaimed-material installations read as inventive and family-legible, but no clear Sacramento tie. Would require advisory liaison and travel logistics for mall-scale commission.

name: Ashley Dreyfus
summary: Branded Arts roster muralist with figurative and portrait-driven work; Sacramento ties not confirmed from listing alone.
suitability: Roster muralist with figurative work that could read warmly in family-retail context. Sacramento connection unverified; would need agency liaison via Branded Arts to confirm fit and availability.

name: Lisa Kokin
summary: Bay Area mixed-media and assemblage artist represented by Kevin Barry; intimate, conceptual studio practice rather than large-scale public mural work.
suitability: Studio-scale conceptual practice with no Sacramento tie and no evident mural portfolio. Off-fit for a regional public-art roster at family-retail scale.

name: Tracie Cheng
summary: Abstract painter known for luminous, layered color fields evoking light and space; represented by Kevin Barry Art Advisory.
suitability: Out-of-region painter with no apparent Sacramento ties. Work is family-appropriate and visually warm, but program prioritizes local artists.

name: Blaine Fontana
summary: Branded Arts roster muralist with a narrative, symbolic figurative style and proven large-scale public work across multiple cities.
suitability: Polished narrative muralist with strong public-scale chops and family-readable imagery. Sacramento tie is not established; would route through Branded Arts as a commissioned guest rather than a local roster pick.

name: Nicholas Biddle
summary: Contemporary painter represented by Kevin Barry Art Advisory; Sacramento ties unverified and public-art scale not evidenced in advisory profile.
suitability: Advisory-represented studio practice with no confirmed Sacramento tie or mural-scale precedent. Would require liaison and regional vetting before consideration for a mall-scale commission.

name: Rossi Sculpture Design
summary: Sculpture studio surfaced via Instagram; dimensional practice could complement a mural-heavy roster pending Sacramento-area verification.
suitability: Three-dimensional practice would diversify a wall-driven program. Sacramento ties and family-fit need verification before commissioning at mall scale.

name: Matt Devine
medium: Steel sculpture · Powder-coated metal · Public art
summary: Sculptor of powder-coated steel geometries represented by Kevin Barry Art Advisory; clean, family-safe abstraction with public-scale precedent.
suitability: Geometric metal sculpture reads cleanly in family-retail contexts and scales for atrium or plaza siting. Sacramento tie unconfirmed; would need verification before roster inclusion.

name: Miguel Antonio Horn
kind: Artist · Representation: Kevin Barry Art Advisory
medium: Public art · Layered steel sculpture · Figurative installation
summary: Layered-steel figurative sculptor represented by Kevin Barry Art Advisory; large-scale public installations with no confirmed Sacramento ties.
suitability: Proven monumental public-art practice reads well at mall scale, but no confirmed Sacramento connection and agency representation would require commission liaison. Worth queuing for a guest slot.

name: Bryan Valenzuela
medium: Mural · Mixed-media on canvas · Glass installation
summary: Sacramento text-figure artist who weaves handwritten language into human forms; created the Arden Fair UnchARTed flagship installation in 2021.
suitability: Native to the program — created the Arden Fair UnchARTed flagship. Narrative, text-woven figuration reads warmly in a family-retail setting and would anchor any cycle.
